newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SNAIGE GAINS BIG ON MIXED BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: SNAIGE GAINS BIG ON MIXED BOURSE.

text.p: * Fridge maker Snaige rose ten percent to 9.35 litas on Monday and share prices were mixed on Lithuania's bourse.
* Dealers said that prices looked set to stabilise and perhaps begin inching up again as sellers are holding out and refusing to sell at low prices.
Lithuania's market was mixed on Monday after a four-day break but dealers said that prices looked set to stabilise as sellers are refusing to let go of their shares at current prices.
"Demand is still low, but there isn't a lot of supply either," said Arvydas Jacikevicius of brokerage house Suprema.
"Sellers seem to be reluctant to sell at such low prices...if this situation continues, the market should soon stabilise," he added.
The session's gainers included Snaige fridge maker, which rose ten percent to 9.35 litas.
Dealers said that bad first quarter results pushed the company's price down but it had room to grow as it is a big factory with lots of potential for success in the future.
Official list company Medienos Plaushas also fared well, rising to 12.99 litas from 12.00 litas.
Losers included tractor parts maker Kuro Aparatura, which fell to 8.17 litas from 9.00 litas.
